title: Autonomous Bot & Messaging Integration
brief: Make PRISM accessible via messaging platforms (Discord/Slack) for autonomous manufacturing assistance, inspired by OpenClaw model. Discord bot scaffold, slash command mapping, conversational context per channel, autonomous pipeline execution, rich embeds, multi-user isolation, notifications, webhook receivers, rate limiting, cross-platform adapter.

phases.title: Autonomous Bot & Messaging Integration
phases.description: Build messaging platform integrations (Discord, Slack, Teams, Telegram) for autonomous PRISM manufacturing assistance. Bot scaffold, slash commands, conversational context, pipeline execution, rich formatting, multi-user isolation, notifications, webhooks, rate limiting, cross-platform abstraction.

units.title: Discord bot scaffold
units.rationale: Create Discord bot that receives manufacturing queries from chat, routes them to PRISM MCP server, and returns results -- the foundation for all messaging integrations.
features: Discord bot connecting to PRISM MCP server
exit_conditions: Bot connects to Discord
Responds to manufacturing queries via MCP
Tests pass: npx vitest run (min 10 cases for engine units)

steps.instruction: Create src/bot/discord-bot.ts using discord.js library
Implement message handler that routes natural language to PRISM dispatchers
Add intent classification: speed/feed query, material lookup, tool search, quote request
Connect to PRISM MCP server via stdio or HTTP transport
Test with basic manufacturing queries in test Discord server

deliverables.description: Discord bot scaffold for PRISM manufacturing queries

units.description: Discord bot scaffold — follow 4-LOOP (BUILD → SCRUTINIZE → GAP FILL → TIE UP), consult KNOWLEDGE_SOURCES before coding, forge-triple ownership in milestone header.

units.title: Slash command mapping
units.rationale: Map top 30 PRISM skills to Discord slash commands with proper parameter definitions, autocomplete, and help text for discoverability.
features: Discord slash commands for PRISM skills
exit_conditions: 30 slash commands registered
Autocomplete works for material/machine/tool parameters
Tests pass: npx vitest run (min 10 cases for engine units)

steps.instruction: Create slash-commands.ts defining all 30 commands with options and descriptions
Map: /calc, /sf, /quote, /material, /tool, /playbook, /simulate, /program, /post, /feasibility
Map: /machine, /alarm, /tribal, /strategy, /novel, /video-replay, /fusion-generate, /auto-speed-feed
Add autocomplete handlers for material (28), machine (25), operation (27) parameters
Register commands with Discord API and test each one

deliverables.description: Discord slash command definitions mapped to PRISM skills

units.description: Slash command mapping — follow 4-LOOP (BUILD → SCRUTINIZE → GAP FILL → TIE UP), consult KNOWLEDGE_SOURCES before coding, forge-triple ownership in milestone header.

units.title: Conversational context
units.rationale: Maintain per-channel context (active machine, material, operation) so users can have flowing conversations without re-specifying parameters in every message.
exit_conditions: Context maintained across messages in same channel
Context includes machine, material, operation, tool
Tests pass: npx vitest run (min 10 cases for engine units)

steps.instruction: Create context-manager.ts with per-channel context store
Track: active machine, material, operation type, tool selection, coolant, workholding
Auto-extract context from messages: 'using Ti-6Al-4V' sets material, 'on DMG DMU 50' sets machine
Pass accumulated context to PRISM dispatchers as default parameters
Add /context command to view/reset current channel context
Implement context expiry: 4 hours inactive = suggest refresh

units.description: Conversational context — follow 4-LOOP (BUILD → SCRUTINIZE → GAP FILL → TIE UP), consult KNOWLEDGE_SOURCES before coding, forge-triple ownership in milestone header.

units.title: Autonomous task execution
units.rationale: Enable users to describe a complete manufacturing job and have the bot autonomously run the full pipeline: speed/feed calculation, program generation, post-processing, and quoting.
features: Full autonomous pipeline execution from chat description
entry_conditions: Slash commands and context manager functional
exit_conditions: User describes job, bot runs full pipeline
Results delivered as structured message
Tests pass: npx vitest run (min 10 cases for engine units)

steps.instruction: Create autonomous-executor.ts that parses job description into pipeline parameters
Orchestrate: material resolve -> tool select -> speed/feed -> program gen -> post-process -> quote
Show progress messages during execution: 'Calculating speeds...', 'Generating program...'
Handle partial specifications: ask for missing critical params, use defaults for optional
Return structured result with key metrics and downloadable G-code attachment

deliverables.description: Autonomous pipeline executor for chat-based manufacturing jobs

units.description: Autonomous task execution — follow 4-LOOP (BUILD → SCRUTINIZE → GAP FILL → TIE UP), consult KNOWLEDGE_SOURCES before coding, forge-triple ownership in milestone header.

units.title: Result formatting — rich embeds
units.rationale: Format PRISM results as rich Discord/Slack embeds with tables, color-coded severity, file attachments for G-code and setup sheets, and collapsible detail sections.
features: Rich embed formatting for messaging platforms
exit_conditions: Rich embeds work for speed/feed, quote, simulation results
File attachments work for G-code
Tests pass: npx vitest run (min 10 cases for engine units)

steps.instruction: Create formatters.ts with embed builders for each result type
Speed/feed: color-coded embed with RPM, feed, depth, warnings
Quote: embed with cycle time, cost breakdown, confidence interval
Simulation: embed with force/thermal/deflection summary, safety status
File attachments: G-code as .nc file, setup sheet as .txt, report as .json
Add table rendering for multi-operation results

deliverables.description: Rich embed formatters for messaging platform results

units.description: Result formatting — rich embeds — follow 4-LOOP (BUILD → SCRUTINIZE → GAP FILL → TIE UP), consult KNOWLEDGE_SOURCES before coding, forge-triple ownership in milestone header.

units.title: Multi-user isolation
units.rationale: Separate user contexts to prevent cross-contamination (one user's machine selection affecting another), while allowing shared shop-floor context per channel.
features: Per-user context isolation with shared channel context
exit_conditions: Users have isolated personal contexts
Shared channel context for shop-floor info
Tests pass: npx vitest run (min 10 cases for engine units)

steps.instruction: Create user-isolation.ts with dual-layer context: user-private + channel-shared
User-private: tool library, preferences, recent queries, custom presets
Channel-shared: shop machine list, default material, coolant setup, workholding
Merge logic: user-private overrides channel-shared for same keys
Admin commands: /set-shop to configure shared context, /my-prefs for private

units.description: Multi-user isolation — follow 4-LOOP (BUILD → SCRUTINIZE → GAP FILL → TIE UP), consult KNOWLEDGE_SOURCES before coding, forge-triple ownership in milestone header.

units.title: Notification integration
units.rationale: Push notifications for build failures, test regressions, catalog updates, cron job results, and long-running task completions to designated channels or DMs.
features: Push notification system for PRISM events
exit_conditions: Notifications sent for build failures, test regressions, task completions
Tests pass: npx vitest run (min 10 cases for engine units)
Typecheck clean: npx tsc --noEmit on touched files

steps.instruction: Create notifications.ts with event-to-channel routing
Build failure: post to #prism-ci with error summary and diff link
Test regression: post to #prism-tests with failing test names and last-passing commit
Catalog update: post to #prism-data with new tool/material counts
Task completion: DM the requesting user with result summary
Configure notification preferences per user/channel

deliverables.description: Push notification system for PRISM events

units.description: Notification integration — follow 4-LOOP (BUILD → SCRUTINIZE → GAP FILL → TIE UP), consult KNOWLEDGE_SOURCES before coding, forge-triple ownership in milestone header.

units.title: Webhook receivers
units.rationale: HTTP endpoints that external systems (CAM software, CNC controllers, CI pipelines) can post events to, which are then routed to appropriate Discord/Slack channels.
features: HTTP webhook receivers for external system events
exit_conditions: Webhooks received from external systems
Events routed to correct channels
Tests pass: npx vitest run (min 10 cases for engine units)

steps.instruction: Create webhook-server.ts with Express HTTP endpoints on configurable port
POST /webhooks/cam — receive CAM system events (job complete, error, tool change)
POST /webhooks/controller — receive CNC controller events (alarm, cycle end, tool break)
POST /webhooks/ci — receive CI pipeline events (build, test, deploy)
Validate webhook signatures, route to notification system
Add webhook registration API for external systems to self-register

deliverables.description: HTTP webhook receiver server for external events

units.description: Webhook receivers — follow 4-LOOP (BUILD → SCRUTINIZE → GAP FILL → TIE UP), consult KNOWLEDGE_SOURCES before coding, forge-triple ownership in milestone header.

units.title: Rate limiting & auth
units.rationale: API key authentication for webhook endpoints, per-user rate limits for bot commands, admin-only commands, and abuse prevention to protect PRISM compute resources.
features: Authentication and rate limiting for bot and webhooks
exit_conditions: Rate limiting active per user
API key auth on webhooks
Admin commands restricted

steps.instruction: Create auth-rate-limit.ts with token bucket rate limiter per user
Default limits: 30 commands/hour per user, 5 pipeline executions/hour
API key auth for webhook endpoints with HMAC signature verification
Admin role check for destructive commands (/set-shop, /reset-context, /manage-keys)
Log rate limit hits and auth failures for monitoring

units.description: Rate limiting & auth — follow 4-LOOP (BUILD → SCRUTINIZE → GAP FILL → TIE UP), consult KNOWLEDGE_SOURCES before coding, forge-triple ownership in milestone header.

units.title: Cross-platform adapter
units.rationale: Abstract the messaging layer so PRISM bot works identically across Discord, Slack, Teams, and Telegram with platform-specific formatting adapters.
exit_conditions: Same bot logic works across Discord, Slack, Teams, Telegram
Tests pass: npx vitest run (min 10 cases for engine units)
Typecheck clean: npx tsc --noEmit on touched files

steps.instruction: Create platform-adapter.ts with abstract PlatformAdapter interface
Define unified message types: text, embed, file, reaction, thread
Implement DiscordAdapter (existing bot), SlackAdapter (Bolt SDK), TeamsAdapter (Bot Framework)
Implement TelegramAdapter (telegraf) with inline keyboard for parameters
Platform-specific formatting: Discord embeds, Slack blocks, Teams adaptive cards
Test same query across all 4 platforms produces equivalent output

units.description: Cross-platform adapter — follow 4-LOOP (BUILD → SCRUTINIZE → GAP FILL → TIE UP), consult KNOWLEDGE_SOURCES before coding, forge-triple ownership in milestone header.
